forest-ink.$description: Forest Ink — Headlines, body copy, navigation text, illustration strokes, link color — the structural color that carries every page

chartreuse-sprig.$description: Chartreuse Sprig — Primary CTA button fill, feature card surfaces, highlight washes — the single accent that makes interactive elements feel switched on

deep-moss.$description: Deep Moss — Secondary action button, hover or pressed states where a darker counterweight to the lime CTA is needed

vivid-lime.$description: Vivid Lime — Decorative high-energy accent inside illustrations, hover halos, or emphasis marks — louder sibling of Chartreuse Sprig

mist-paper.$description: Mist Paper — Page canvas, hairline borders across cards/links/images, subtle section backgrounds — the surface that the design breathes on

white-sheet.$description: White Sheet — Card surfaces, elevated tiles, button backgrounds, inverse text on dark fills

graphite.$description: Graphite — Occasional true-black fills for SVG details and one dark button variant

sage-dust.$description: Sage Dust — Muted helper text, secondary descriptions, caption-level copy where full Forest Ink would compete with the headline

pine-shadow.$description: Pine Shadow — Tertiary text, subdued labels, low-priority annotations

untitledsans.$description: Primary interface typeface — UI controls, body, navigation, and display headings. The aggressively negative tracking at large sizes (up to -0.064em) tightens the letterforms into a near-poster density that makes even short headlines feel like brand statements. A 600 weight is reserved for emphasis and CTA labels.

boogybrutposter.$description: Decorative italic-display accent used for the hand-lettered-feel phrases that ride alongside the geometric headline ('for You & the Planet', 'Fast by nature', '& love'). The contrast between this organic, almost-calligraphic display and UntitledSans's clinical geometry is the site's signature typographic move.

sans-serif.$description: sans-serif — detected in extracted data but not described by AI
